items.title: Christopher "Happy" Goldston Interview, 1962-04-11
items.q: He was playing snare drum, I was playing bass drum.

ctx.x: He was playing snare drum, I was playing bass drum. And then old man just taught me off that old man Allen. And I just keep it up and that would make him find me and then laugh. And so, on the line, Allen had a cap. A band cap, a Likon, a Likon band. That dear And I just show you how you say things and don't know what you're saying. I said, I don't buy no cap. I said, that cap suits you. It's good enough for you. I said, just show you buy any new cap, you're going to die. And God knows that, I bought that cap and…
So you were with him almost to the end, huh?
